candidates.name: Dorra (Durra) Gas Field Export Pipeline (Saudi share)
aka: Khafji Joint Operations Dorra gas transmission pipeline
candidates.sponsor: Khafji Joint Operations (Aramco Gulf Operations Company [AGOC] + Kuwait Gulf Oil Company [KGOC])
candidates.from: Dorra field central gathering platform (Saudi-Kuwait Neutral/Divided Zone, offshore Persian Gulf)
candidates.to: Al-Khafji onshore gas processing plant, Saudi Arabia

evidence.note: KJO awarded offshore Package 1 (7 jackets + intra-field lines) to Larsen & Toubro on 2025-10-28. States Package 2B (central gathering platform) covers 'pipelines for gas and condensate transmission to each shareholder', i.e. a transmission line to the Saudi (Khafji) side; Package 2B not yet awarded.
Contractors submitted bids for the ~$10bn Dorra offshore gas development (3 offshore + 1 onshore EPC packages); Package 2B = central gathering platform complex plus export pipelines and cables.

Dorra offshore field (Neutral Zone) targeting ~1 bcf/d gas shared equally by Saudi Arabia and Kuwait, each piped separately to its own territory; Saudi gas lands at the Khafji onshore processing plant (up to 632 mmcf/d).
Background on the Khafji/Neutral-Zone joint development operated by KJO (AGOC + KGOC) landing hydrocarbons in Saudi Khafji.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Cross-Neutral-Zone gas transmission line from the shared Dorra/Arash offshore field landing in Saudi Arabia (Khafji); not in the roster. Nearest roster rows are different projects: P5854 Wafra-Station 171 is the ONSHORE Wafra Joint Operations line (not the offshore Dorra field), and P2702 Al Khafji Joint Operations Offshore is a crude line. BORDERLINE: this is a shared-field export line rather than a classic country-to-country interconnector, and the transmission-pipeline package (2B) is still in tender (pre-award), so it may be judged a field/gathering export rather than a standalone transmission entry — consolidator to decide.
